NightSight.title: Night Sight
lines: You can see in the dark.

ActiveMeditation.title: Meditating
lines: Your mana regenerates twice as fast.

Paralyze.title: Paralyzed
lines: You are frozen and cannot move.

protection.title: Protection
lines: Each hit has a {chance}% chance of not interrupting your spell.

archProtection.title: Arch Protection
lines: Your armor rating is raised by {bonus}.

reactiveArmor.title: Reactive Armor
lines: Absorbs melee hits and sends a fifth of the damage back.
{points} points left; a hit of that size or more ends it.

magicReflect.title: Magic Reflection
lines: {points} points left; each spell uses its circle plus one.

poison.title: Poisoned
lines: You lose health until it wears off or you are cured.

knockedOut.title: Knocked Out
lines: You cannot act until you recover.

criminal.title: Criminal
lines: Guards will attack you, and anyone may attack you.

intent.title: Criminal Intent
lines: While it is on you appear grey and other players may attack you.
Killing a player who has it on is not murder.

wardPrimed.title: Backpack Ward: Primed
lines: It is tracking thieves who steal from you.
After {minutes} minutes without a theft attempt it resets.

wardActivated.title: Backpack Ward: Activated
lines: A thief it caught cannot steal from you again.
After {minutes} minutes without a theft attempt it is used up.

faintMemoriesLocked.title: Faint Memories
lines: {points} free skill points unlock in about {unlock}.

faintMemoriesReady.title: Faint Memories
lines: Train a skill set to Up and they come back to you.
